description: This Java source file defines the custom exception class 'ThingDefinitionNotAccessibleException' within the 'org.eclipse.ditto.signals.commands.things.exceptions' package. It models an exception to be thrown when a thing's definition is not accessible due to absence or insufficient permissions, including related builder methods and JSON integration.

classes.name: ThingDefinitionNotAccessibleException
classes.description: A final class extending DittoRuntimeException that represents an exception when the definition of a 'Thing' cannot be accessed either because it does not exist or due to insufficient permissions.
